projects.title: PowerShell + Microsoft Graph JML automation
projects.goal: Automate Joiner/Mover/Leaver for a test tenant: create users from CSV, assign groups by department, disable and strip access on leave, log every change.
steps: Get a free Microsoft 365 developer/trial tenant (or use Entra free tier)
Install Microsoft.Graph PowerShell; connect with least-privilege scopes
Write New-Joiner.ps1 reading users.csv → New-MgUser + group membership by dept
Write Move-User.ps1 swapping groups on dept change
Write Remove-Leaver.ps1: disable, revoke sessions, remove groups, export audit CSV
Add -WhatIf support and a log file
Push to your own GitHub repo with README and sample CSV (fake data only)
projects.resume: Built PowerShell/Microsoft Graph automation for joiner-mover-leaver lifecycle with least-privilege scopes, WhatIf safety and audit logging, mirroring my production JML work for 200+ users.
projects.interview: Walk through how you'd prevent orphaned access, why least-privilege Graph scopes matter, and how you tested safely.

projects.title: Entra Conditional Access baseline
projects.goal: Design and document a Conditional Access baseline: MFA for all, block legacy auth, admin protections, device compliance, break-glass accounts.
steps: Create 2 break-glass accounts excluded from all policies
Build policies in report-only mode first
Require MFA for admins; then all users
Block legacy authentication
Require compliant device for sensitive apps (doc if no Intune)
Use What If tool and sign-in logs to validate
Export policies as JSON (Graph) into your repo
projects.resume: Designed a Conditional Access baseline (MFA, legacy-auth block, admin protection, break-glass) validated with report-only mode and What If, exported as code.
projects.interview: Explain report-only rollout, break-glass design and how you'd handle exceptions.

projects.title: PIM + access reviews
projects.goal: Show privileged access done right: just-in-time admin roles, approval, and recurring access reviews.
steps: Enable Entra ID P2 trial
Make Global/User Admin roles eligible (not active) in PIM
Require MFA + justification + approval on activation
Set max activation 4 hours; enable alerts
Create quarterly access review for privileged roles and a group
Complete a review; document outcomes
projects.resume: Implemented Entra PIM just-in-time access with approval and MFA, plus recurring access reviews, reducing standing admin privilege to zero in a lab tenant.
projects.interview: Why JIT beats standing access, how reviews support SOX audits.

projects.title: Okta SSO (SAML) + SCIM provisioning demo
projects.goal: Connect a SaaS/test app to Okta with SAML SSO and SCIM automatic provisioning.
steps: Sign up for a free Okta Integrator (developer) org
Add a SAML app (e.g., a SAML test SP) and configure ACS/Entity ID
Assign users/groups; test SP- and IdP-initiated login
Capture a SAML assertion with SAML-tracer and annotate it
Enable SCIM to an app that supports it (or a SCIM test server) and show create/deactivate
Document the flow with a diagram

projects.interview: Explain the SAML flow end to end and what SCIM solves.

projects.title: IAM audit report script
projects.goal: One script that produces an access hygiene report: stale accounts, users without MFA, guests, privileged role holders, apps with expiring secrets.
steps: Use Graph PowerShell or Python (msgraph) with read-only scopes
Query sign-in activity for 90-day stale users
Report MFA registration status
List guests and privileged role members
List app registrations with secrets expiring in 30 days
Output an HTML/CSV report; schedule it
projects.resume: Wrote an automated IAM hygiene report (stale accounts, MFA gaps, privileged roles, expiring app secrets) using read-only Microsoft Graph.
projects.interview: How you'd prioritize findings and turn them into remediation tickets.
